stories.title: Like father, like son: Chinese duo build mini national engineering marvels in home lab

en.title: Like father, like son: Chinese duo build mini national engineering marvels in home lab
en.summary: A Shanghai father and 13-year-old son have constructed miniature replicas of Chinese national engineering projects in their home laboratory, including turbojet engines and electromagnetic aircraft launch systems.

en.title: National Day holiday: Hohhot residents enjoy leisure time accompanied by books
en.summary: During the October 7 National Day holiday period, residents and children in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia visited bookstores to read and browse books.

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry announced: 2 scientists awarded
en.summary: The Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for their discoveries in nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

stories.title: Hong Kong finance chief says economy grew in third quarter, warns of external risks

en.title: Hong Kong finance chief says economy grew in third quarter, warns of external risks
en.summary: Hong Kong's finance chief reported third-quarter economic growth driven by strong exports and tourism, while cautioning about Middle East tensions and inflation risks. He maintained confidence in achieving 3.5 to 4.5 percent annual growth.

stories.title: Despite rising yields and political gridlock, France not facing a debt crisis: analysts

en.title: Despite rising yields and political gridlock, France not facing a debt crisis: analysts
en.summary: French borrowing costs have increased significantly, widening the yield spread with German bonds to levels unseen since the eurozone crisis. However, analysts maintain that France is not experiencing a debt crisis, though they note ongoing uncertainties remain.

stories.title: Nobel Chemistry Prize awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai

en.title: Nobel Chemistry Prize awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
en.summary: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai have been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis, which relates to understanding chiral molecules that exist in mirror-image forms.

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry Announced
en.summary: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced on October 7 that two scientists will receive the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

en.title: Changchun Winter Universiade Torch and Medals Officially Released
en.summary: With 100 days until the opening of the 2027 Changchun Winter Universiade, organizers have officially unveiled the torch and medals for the 33rd World University Winter Sports Games, along with the event's promotional song and official uniforms.

en.title: Major National Equipment in Place! How Powerful is the World's Largest Capacity 'Power Heart'
en.summary: China plans to invest over 5 trillion yuan in building a new power grid during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. A world record-breaking flexible direct current transformer, the largest capacity of its kind, has been installed in central Guangzhou.

en.title: Shaanxi Xi'an: Qinling Giant Pandas' Adorable Antics Draw Visitors
en.summary: Giant pandas at a wildlife park in Xi'an are entertaining visitors with playful behavior, alternating between resting in water and rolling on grass. The endearing display of the iconic animals attracts crowds of tourists to watch.

stories.title: 香港财库局局长向千余名业界代表推介香港黄金交易生态圈

en.title: Hong Kong Finance Secretary Presents Gold Trading Ecosystem to Over a Thousand Industry Representatives
en.summary: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary introduced the territory's developing gold trading ecosystem to industry delegates at a global precious metals conference in Italy. The initiative, led by the government and supported by commercial activity and market infrastructure, aims to strengthen Hong Kong's position in gold trading.

stories.title: （乡村行·看振兴）福建桂峰村：古厝晒秋引客来 文旅融合焕新生

en.title: (Rural Revitalization) Guifeng Village, Fujian: Autumn Drying in Ancient Dwellings Attracts Visitors, Cultural Tourism Brings New Life
en.summary: Guifeng Village, a historic cultural site in Fujian, displays traditional autumn drying scenes with peppers, corn, pumpkins and grain spread across ancient rooftops and racks. The colorful seasonal harvest display attracts tourists who gather to photograph and admire the picturesque landscape.

stories.title: Why Morgan Stanley sees more upside in Hong Kong offices than New York towers

en.title: Why Morgan Stanley sees more upside in Hong Kong offices than New York towers
en.summary: Morgan Stanley believes Hong Kong's office market has greater upside potential than New York despite higher interest rates affecting both property markets. The investment bank notes similarities between the two financial centers, including aligned monetary policies and limited land supply.

stories.title: Family offices branch out into private equity, infrastructure and alternative investments

en.title: Family offices branch out into private equity, infrastructure and alternative investments
en.summary: Asian family offices led by second and third-generation owners are expanding into diverse investment areas including private equity and infrastructure rather than abandoning founding principles. These investors continue assessing opportunities and adjusting portfolios for optimal risk-return balance.

stories.title: Asian investors turn to housing, real assets as global tension shakes market confidence

en.title: Asian investors turn to housing, real assets as global tension shakes market confidence
en.summary: Asian investors are shifting away from private credit toward real estate and other real assets amid macroeconomic uncertainties. Interest in real estate rose to 52 percent from 39 percent while private credit interest dropped significantly to 48 percent from 71 percent.

stories.title: US firm ArriVent’s plunge shows risks facing China’s biotech expansion into global markets

en.title: US firm ArriVent's plunge shows risks facing China's biotech expansion into global markets
en.summary: ArriVent BioPharma's stock fell nearly 47 percent after its cancer drug firmonertinib, licensed from Shanghai Allist Pharmaceuticals, failed to meet primary objectives in a phase 3 trial. The setback illustrates challenges Chinese biotech companies face when expanding internationally.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s MPF has gained nearly HK$100b this year despite September loss: report

en.title: Hong Kong's MPF has gained nearly HK$100b this year despite September loss: report
en.summary: Hong Kong's Mandatory Provident Fund generated nearly HK$100 billion in gains during the first nine months of 2024, with an average return of 6.2 percent across its 382 investment funds, despite posting losses in September.
